steps.say: Upper tract urothelial carcinoma is uncommon but aggressive. Five to 10 percent of urothelial cancers are upper tract in origin. Six in ten cases are invasive at first presentation. Bladder tumours are invasive in only 15 to 25 percent. The thin ureteric wall is breached early by growing tumours. Every upper tract lesion is staged as high risk.
steps.tx: **Upper tract urothelial carcinoma** (UTUC (upper urine tract cancer)) forms **5% to 10%** (five to ten in a hundred) of urothelial cancers, yet **60%** (six in ten) are **invasive at presentation** (already deep at diagnosis) versus 15% to 25% of bladder tumours. The thin ureteric wall lets tumours through early, because lamina propria invasion meets muscle within millimetres. Treat every upper tract lesion as high risk until staging proves otherwise.

vis.alt: Urothelial carcinoma with papillary and flat lesions in the urinary tract.
vis.caption: Urothelial carcinoma patterns: upper tract tumours invade early through the thin wall. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Lynch syndrome is an inherited mismatch repair defect. MSH2, MLH1, MSH6, and PMS2 mutations are responsible. Lifetime UTUC risk is raised 14- to 22-fold. Annual urine cytology is advised for known carriers. Upper tract imaging is performed alongside bowel surveillance. Urothelial tumours are included in the cancer spectrum.
steps.tx: **Lynch syndrome** (inherited bowel cancer syndrome, HNPCC (hereditary colon cancer)) raises lifetime UTUC risk **14- to 22-fold** (fourteen to twenty two times) through germline **mismatch repair** (DNA spellcheck) defects in **MSH2** (most common), MLH1, MSH6, and PMS2. Screen carriers with annual urine cytology and upper tract imaging, because urothelial tumours join the colorectal and endometrial spectrum.

steps.say: Aristolochic acid is a herbal toxin that scars the kidneys. Balkan endemic nephropathy is the classic regional form. Bilateral upper tract cancers are grown after exposure. A to T transversions are found in the TP53 gene. Herbal remedy histories are taken in unexplained failure. The toxin is retained in remedies for years.
steps.tx: **Aristolochic acid** (herbal toxin) nephropathy, seen as **Balkan endemic nephropathy** (Danube kidney disease) and Chinese herb disease, scars the cortex and grows bilateral extensive UTUC with hallmark A:T to T:A transversions in **TP53** (guardian gene). Ask about herbal weight loss remedies in unexplained renal failure, because the toxin persists in remedies for years.

vis.alt: Cortical atrophy with renal pelvis urothelial carcinoma in aristolochic nephropathy.
vis.caption: Aristolochic nephropathy with pelvis tumour: herbal toxins grow bilateral upper tract cancers. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Radical nephroureterectomy is the gold standard for high risk disease. The kidney and full length ureter are removed together. The ipsilateral bladder cuff is excised en bloc. Piecemeal removal is avoided as it seeds tumour. One piece excision is performed through open or robotic access. Cure is best with complete early surgery.
steps.tx: **Radical nephroureterectomy** (whole kidney and ureter removal, RNU (complete upper tract excision)) with en bloc excision of the ipsilateral **bladder cuff** (bladder rim around the opening) is the gold standard for high risk UTUC. Remove kidney, full length ureter, and cuff as one piece, because piecemeal excision seeds tumour across the field.

steps.say: Bladder cuff recurrence is seen in 30 to 50 percent after incomplete surgery. The ureteral stump and hemitrigone are the usual sites. The intramural ureter is always dissected to the bladder. The orifice is excised with a rim of bladder. Retained urothelium is known to keep malignant potential. Complete primary excision is required for cure.
steps.tx: Leaving the intramural ureter or **bladder cuff** behind invites **bladder cuff recurrence** (regrowth at the stump) in **30% to 50%** (three to five in ten) at the **ureteral stump** (cut end) or ipsilateral hemitrigone. Always dissect to the bladder and excise the orifice with a rim, because urothelium left behind keeps its malignant potential.

steps.say: Kidney sparing surgery is offered for low risk tumours. Unifocal disease under 2 cm is suitable for ablation. Low grade non invasive histology is required. Solitary kidneys and bilateral disease are imperative indications. Lifelong ureteroscopy is arranged for regular surveillance. Recurrence elsewhere is watched for at each visit.
steps.tx: **Kidney-sparing surgery** (endoscopic laser ablation or **segmental ureterectomy** (partial tube excision)) suits low risk UTUC that is unifocal, under **2 cm** (two centimetres), low grade, and non invasive, or imperative cases such as a solitary kidney or bilateral disease. Survey the spared system lifelong with ureteroscopy and cytology, because recurrence elsewhere in the urothelium is common.

steps.say: A single bladder instillation is given after nephroureterectomy. Mitomycin C or pirarubicin is instilled within 2 to 10 days. Bladder recurrence is reduced by 40 to 50 percent. Floating tumour cells are killed before implantation. Treatment is timed once haematuria has settled. One dose is sufficient for prophylaxis.
steps.tx: One postoperative bladder instillation of **mitomycin C** (anti tumour dye) or pirarubicin within **2 to 10 days** (two to ten days) of nephroureterectomy halves later bladder tumours, cutting **bladder recurrence** (new bladder growths) by **40% to 50%** (four to five in ten). Give a single dose once haematuria settles, because early floating tumour cells seed the raw bladder.

steps.say: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy is offered for locally advanced disease. Gemcitabine cisplatin is administered as the standard doublet before nephroureterectomy. Downstaging is achieved in a substantial proportion. Overall survival is improved by early systemic treatment. Cisplatin fitness is confirmed by renal and hearing checks. Split dosing is avoided as it weakens benefit.
steps.tx: **Neoadjuvant chemotherapy** (drugs before surgery) with the **gemcitabine cisplatin** (GC doublet) combination downstages locally advanced high risk UTUC and improves overall survival before nephroureterectomy. Confirm fitness for cisplatin with renal function and hearing checks, because split dose or carboplatin substitution weakens the benefit.
